title: Where each protection checks the traffic
claim: Shield guards the edge, AWS WAF checks each web request, and Network Firewall checks traffic that leaves the VPC.
alt: Users reach CloudFront and Shield Standard at the edge. A web ACL checks each request. Outbound traffic passes the NAT gateway, then Network Firewall.

edges.say: At the edge, Shield Standard protects CloudFront against network and transport layer DDoS attacks.

edges.label: check
edges.say: The web ACL of AWS WAF allows or blocks each request.
Allowed requests reach the load balancer and the application.
Outbound traffic passes the NAT gateway, then Network Firewall.

notes: Chapter 08 hero (1-fast.md#in-one-breath). One Availability Zone; the internet gateway is in the last edge label. Shield Standard has no arrow; it sits in the edge location box beside CloudFront. Step facts in the Markdown: shield-standard-automatic-no-charge (1).
